scope: Travis County (Austin, Pflugerville, Manor, Del Valle)

records.name: Central Texas Food Bank - Find Food Now
records.description_en: The food bank helps you find free food near you, including mobile food pantries, local pantries, and food programs for kids and older adults.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone who needs food can get help. The food bank says no ID, proof of income, or citizenship papers are required.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food Now tool on the food bank website and enter your ZIP code to see pantries and mobile pantry dates. At a pantry you may fill out a short form about where you live and your need.
records.notes: Serves many Central Texas counties, including Travis. For weather/holiday closures call 512-684-2559. 24/7 multilingual help also at 2-1-1 or 877-541-7905.
records.description_es: El banco de comida le ayuda a encontrar comida gratis cerca de usted, como despensas móviles, despensas locales y programas de comida para niños y personas mayores.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que necesite comida puede recibir ayuda. El banco de comida dice que no se pide identificación, prueba de ingresos ni papeles de ciudadanía.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta Find Food Now en la página web del banco de comida y escriba su código postal para ver despensas y fechas de despensas móviles. En la despensa tal vez le pidan llenar una hoja corta sobre dónde vive y lo que necesita.

records.name: SNAP and Benefits Application Help
records.description_en: Food bank staff help you apply for SNAP food benefits and other state benefits like Medicaid, CHIP, TANF, and Healthy Texas Women.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the food bank's service area who want help applying for state benefits. The state decides who qualifies.
records.how_to_apply: Call the benefits line or request an appointment on the food bank website to apply by phone or online with a staff member.
records.notes: Application assistance only; eligibility for SNAP/Medicaid/TANF is decided by Texas HHSC.
records.description_es: El personal del banco de comida le ayuda a solicitar beneficios de comida SNAP y otros beneficios del estado como Medicaid, CHIP, TANF y Healthy Texas Women.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área del banco de comida que quieren ayuda para solicitar beneficios del estado. El estado decide quién califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de beneficios o pida una cita en la página web del banco de comida para hacer su solicitud por teléfono o en línea con alguien del personal.

records.name: Travis County Food Pantry
records.organization: Travis County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Travis County gives free food for about 5 days, including fresh and frozen foods, canned goods, dry goods, cereal, and snacks. Staff bring the food to your car.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Travis County residents. You can get food once every 30 days at any of the six Travis County Community Centers.
documents_needed: No ID needed unless someone else picks up food for you
Name, address, and household size
Government assistance or income information
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the application online or at a Travis County Community Center (computer, QR code, or paper form). Scheduling an appointment is optional but recommended.
records.notes: Available at Del Valle, Manor, Pflugerville, Oak Hill, Jonestown, and Central Austin community centers.
records.description_es: El condado de Travis da comida gratis para unos 5 días, como comida fresca y congelada, latas, comida seca, cereal y botanas. El personal le lleva la comida a su carro.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Travis. Puede recibir comida una vez cada 30 días en cualquiera de los seis centros comunitarios del condado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea o en un centro comunitario del condado de Travis (en computadora, con código QR o en papel). Hacer una cita no es obligatorio, pero se recomienda.

records.name: Meals on Wheels Central Texas
records.description_en: Delivers meals to people at home and serves meals at senior centers. Also offers grocery delivery, in-home care, and home repair programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Services have eligibility requirements; call or fill out the online inquiry form to find out if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-476-MEAL or fill out the Inquire About Services form on the website.
records.notes: Phone is listed as 512-476-MEAL (6325). Eligibility details and cost were not stated on the homepage.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas a la casa de las personas y sirve comidas en centros para personas mayores. También ofrece entrega de despensa, cuidado en casa y reparaciones del hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los servicios tienen requisitos. Llame o llene el formulario en línea para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 512-476-MEAL (6325) o llene el formulario "Inquire About Services" en la página web.

records.name: Mobile Loaves & Fishes Truck Ministry and Community First! Village
records.description_en: Food trucks bring meals, clothing, and hygiene items to people experiencing homelessness seven nights a week. The group also runs Community First! Village, which offers permanent affordable housing.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Truck services are for people experiencing homelessness and the working poor in Austin. Community First! Village is for adults 18+ who are chronically homeless, have a disability, have steady income (such as SSI, SSDI, or work), and have lived in the Austin area for the past year.
records.how_to_apply: Check the truck schedule on the website to find a stop. To apply for a home at Community First! Village: first complete a Coordinated Assessment, watch the 30-minute Potential Neighbor Tour video, then email your housing application to housing@mlf.org.
records.notes: Phone is the Community First! Village housing hotline (listed on mlf.org). Truck schedules: mlf.org/truck-schedules/. Village minimum income: $600/month (microhomes) and up. Village accepts residents from Travis, Williamson, Hays, Caldwell, or Bastrop counties.
records.description_es: Camiones de comida llevan comidas, ropa y artículos de higiene a personas sin hogar siete noches a la semana. El grupo también maneja Community First! Village, que ofrece vivienda permanente a bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los camiones sirven a personas sin hogar y a trabajadores de bajos ingresos en Austin. Community First! Village es para adultos de 18 años o más que han estado sin hogar por mucho tiempo, tienen una discapacidad, tienen ingresos fijos (como SSI, SSDI o trabajo) y han vivido en el área de Austin el último año.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise el horario de los camiones en la página web para encontrar una parada. Para pedir una casa en Community First! Village: primero haga la Evaluación Coordinada (Coordinated Assessment), vea el video de 30 minutos "Potential Neighbor Tour" y luego mande su solicitud por correo electrónico a housing@mlf.org.

records.name: Travis County Del Valle Community Center
records.organization: Travis County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: A Travis County community center where residents can apply for the county food pantry and for help paying utility bills.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Travis County residents. Each program has its own rules; utility help has income limits.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the center to ask about services. Applications for the food pantry and utility help can also be done online.
records.notes: Hours and a full list of services were not listed on the county page; call ahead.
records.description_es: Un centro comunitario del condado de Travis donde los residentes pueden solicitar la despensa de comida del condado y ayuda para pagar los recibos de luz, gas y agua.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Travis. Cada programa tiene sus propias reglas; la ayuda con servicios públicos tiene límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite el centro para preguntar por los servicios. También puede hacer la solicitud de la despensa y de la ayuda con servicios públicos en línea.

records.name: Travis County Utility Assistance (including CEAP)
records.organization: Travis County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Helps pay electric, gas, propane, water, and trash bills, and firewood used as the main heat source. This is the local provider of the state CEAP energy assistance program.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Travis County residents who meet income limits. For federally funded CEAP help, you must show U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status.
documents_needed: Government-issued photo ID
Proof of Travis County residence
Current utility bill(s)
Proof of income for the last 30 days for everyone 18 and older
For CEAP: proof of U.S. citizenship or immigration status
records.how_to_apply: Complete the online prescreening and application, apply in person at any of the six Travis County Community Centers, or request a paper application by mail. Applications sent by email are not accepted.
records.notes: The page lists no direct phone; contact any of the six Travis County Community Centers or call 2-1-1. If your utilities are already disconnected, contact a community center after applying. Exact income limits were not listed on the page.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar recibos de luz, gas, propano, agua y basura, y la leña si es su forma principal de calefacción. Es el proveedor local del programa estatal de ayuda de energía CEAP.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Travis que cumplen con los límites de ingresos. Para la ayuda CEAP, que viene de fondos federales, debe mostrar ciudadanía de EE. UU. o un estatus migratorio que califique.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la revisión previa y la solicitud en línea (hay versión en español), solicite en persona en cualquiera de los seis centros comunitarios del condado, o pida una solicitud en papel por correo. No se aceptan solicitudes por correo electrónico.

records.name: Dove Springs Neighborhood Center
records.organization: Austin Public Health - Neighborhood Services Unit
records.description_en: A City of Austin neighborhood center that offers food help, job search help, bus passes, child care seats, notary service, help applying for benefits and health insurance, health screenings, and short-term counseling. It also connects people to the city's rent and utility help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Austin/Travis County residents. Rent and utility help is for leaseholders with past-due bills and household income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level.
documents_needed: Proof of income (recent pay stubs, employer letter, Social Security, unemployment, or pension statements)
Proof of financial hardship (for example job loss or medical bills)
Lease in your name (for rent help)
Past-due bill
records.how_to_apply: Call the center to ask about services. For rent or utility bill help, call the Rental and Utility Assistance line at 512-972-5780 (walk-ins are no longer accepted for rent/utility help).
records.hours: Mon-Thu 7:30 a.m.-5 p.m. (closed noon-12:30 p.m.); Fri 8 a.m.-12 p.m.
records.notes: Rent/utility help rules: Austin/Travis County resident, name on the lease, past-due bills, income at or below 200% FPL. South Austin Neighborhood Center (2508 Durwood St.) is closed for building repairs.
records.description_es: Un centro vecinal de la Ciudad de Austin que ofrece ayuda con comida, ayuda para buscar trabajo, pases de autobús, lugares de cuidado infantil, servicio de notario, ayuda para solicitar beneficios y seguro médico, revisiones de salud y consejería de corto plazo. También le conecta con la ayuda de la ciudad para renta y servicios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Austin y el condado de Travis. La ayuda con renta y servicios públicos es para personas con su nombre en el contrato de renta, con pagos atrasados y con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al centro para preguntar por los servicios. Para ayuda con la renta o recibos de servicios, llame a la línea de Ayuda con Renta y Servicios al 512-972-5780 (ya no se atiende sin cita para esta ayuda).

records.name: Rental and Utility Assistance Program
records.organization: Austin Public Health - Neighborhood Services Unit
records.description_en: Limited funds to help pay rent and Austin Energy bills for people facing a money crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Austin/Travis County residents who hold the lease, have past-due bills, and have household income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level.
documents_needed: Proof of income
Proof of financial hardship
Lease in your name
Past-due rent or utility bill
records.how_to_apply: Call the Rental and Utility Assistance line at 512-972-5780. Requests are taken by phone only; walk-ins are no longer accepted.
records.notes: Funds are limited. The city's 'I Belong in Austin' Emergency Rental Assistance portal closed indefinitely after its March 1-7, 2026 application period; do not refer clients there.
records.description_es: Fondos limitados para ayudar a pagar la renta y los recibos de Austin Energy a personas que pasan por una crisis de dinero.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Austin y el condado de Travis con su nombre en el contrato de renta, con pagos atrasados y con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de Ayuda con Renta y Servicios al 512-972-5780. Solo se aceptan pedidos por teléfono; ya no se atiende sin cita.

records.name: Customer Assistance Program (CAP) Utility Bill Discounts
records.organization: City of Austin Utilities (Austin Energy / Austin Water)
records.description_en: Lowers monthly Austin Energy, Austin Water, and drainage bills for customers with low or fixed incomes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residential City of Austin utility customers who get Medicaid, SNAP, CHIP, SSI, Telephone Lifeline, VASH, Central Health MAP, or Travis County CEAP, or whose household income is under 200% of the federal poverty level.
documents_needed: Official letter showing current enrollment in a qualifying program (for example a Medicaid Notice of Case Action), or proof of income. An ID card alone is not accepted.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at cityofaustindiscountprogram.com (English or Spanish), or call City of Austin Customer Care with questions.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 7 a.m.-9 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.-1 p.m.
records.notes: Toll-free 888-340-6465 (VRS accepted). 2025 income limit example: $31,300/year for 1 person; $64,300 for a family of 4. Discounts average about $1,092 per year.
records.description_es: Baja el pago mensual de Austin Energy, Austin Water y drenaje para clientes con ingresos bajos o fijos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para clientes residenciales de los servicios de la Ciudad de Austin que reciben Medicaid, SNAP, CHIP, SSI, Lifeline telefónico, VASH, MAP de Central Health o CEAP del condado de Travis, o cuyo ingreso del hogar es menor al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en cityofaustindiscountprogram.com (en inglés o español), o llame a Atención al Cliente de la Ciudad de Austin si tiene preguntas.

records.name: Plus 1 Emergency Utility Bill Assistance
records.description_en: An emergency fund that gives one-time help to residential customers who have a short-term problem paying their City of Austin utility bill.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residential City of Austin utility customers with a temporary financial hardship.
records.how_to_apply: Call City of Austin Customer Care or contact a City of Austin Neighborhood Center.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 7 a.m.-9 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.-1 p.m.
records.notes: The city also keeps a registry for medically vulnerable customers who rely on utility service.
records.description_es: Un fondo de emergencia que da ayuda de una sola vez a clientes residenciales que tienen un problema temporal para pagar su recibo de servicios de la Ciudad de Austin.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para clientes residenciales de los servicios de la Ciudad de Austin que pasan por un problema de dinero temporal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Atención al Cliente de la Ciudad de Austin o comuníquese con un centro vecinal de la Ciudad de Austin.

records.name: Coordinated Assessment for Housing
records.description_en: A short housing survey (under an hour) that puts you in line for most housing programs for people experiencing homelessness in Austin and Travis County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in a shelter, car, tent, or other place not meant for living, or fleeing domestic violence. People couch-surfing usually do not qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center or The SAFE Alliance, go to a drop-in location, or ask an outreach worker to complete the assessment with you.
records.notes: ECHO does not provide direct services. Phone lines: Sunrise 512-522-1097 (Mon-Fri 8a-8p); The SAFE Alliance 512-267-7233 (by appointment). Drop-ins: Sunrise (4430 Menchaca Rd, M-F 9-1), Austin Community Court (505 Barton Springs Rd, Tue 10-2), The Charlie Center (12675 Research Blvd, Tue-Thu 10-1), Austin Area Urban League (8011 Cameron Rd Suite A-100, Tue & Fri 10-1).
records.description_es: Una encuesta corta de vivienda (menos de una hora) que le pone en la lista para la mayoría de los programas de vivienda para personas sin hogar en Austin y el condado de Travis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en un albergue, carro, tienda de campaña u otro lugar que no es para vivir, o que huyen de violencia doméstica. Las personas que se quedan en casas de otros por lo general no califican.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center o a The SAFE Alliance, vaya a un lugar de atención sin cita, o pida a un trabajador de alcance que le ayude a hacer la evaluación.

records.name: Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center
records.description_en: A place where people experiencing homelessness can drop in or call to complete the Coordinated Assessment and get connected to housing programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people experiencing homelessness in Austin/Travis County.
records.how_to_apply: Call during phone hours or drop in during walk-in hours to do a Coordinated Assessment.
records.hours: Phone: Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-8 p.m.; drop-in: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-1 p.m.
records.notes: Details confirmed on ECHO's Get Help page, not the center's own site.
records.description_es: Un lugar donde las personas sin hogar pueden llegar o llamar para hacer la Evaluación Coordinada y conectarse con programas de vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas sin hogar en Austin y el condado de Travis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame en el horario de teléfono o llegue en el horario sin cita para hacer la Evaluación Coordinada.

records.name: SAFEline Hotline and Survivor Services
records.description_en: A free, private 24/7 hotline for people hurt by domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, or trafficking. SAFE also offers shelter, housing help, counseling, and legal services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, exploitation, or sex trafficking.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the SAFEline any time (text the word SAFE to 737-888-7233), or use the online chat on the SAFE website. If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
records.hours: Hotline 24/7
records.notes: Text line: 737-888-7233. Relay/VRS available for Deaf, DeafBlind, and hard of hearing callers. Interpretation for other languages. SAFE can also complete the Coordinated Assessment by appointment. Admin line 512-369-5900. In-person advocacy hours were not confirmed this session.
records.description_es: Una línea gratis y privada, las 24 horas, para personas afectadas por violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, abuso infantil o trata de personas. SAFE también ofrece albergue, ayuda con vivienda, consejería y servicios legales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, abuso infantil, explotación o trata sexual.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un texto a SAFEline a cualquier hora (mande la palabra SAFE al 737-888-7233), o use el chat en la página web de SAFE. Hay personal que habla español. Si está en peligro ahora, llame al 911.

records.name: Salvation Army Austin - Shelter and Homelessness Prevention
records.organization: The Salvation Army Austin Metropolitan Area Command
records.description_en: Runs emergency shelters, including the Austin Shelter and the Rathgeber Center for families. Also offers meals and rent and utility help to prevent homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people and families in crisis or experiencing homelessness in the Austin area. Contact the office for program rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the main office to ask about shelter or rent and utility help.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-4:30 p.m.
records.notes: Also 1-800-SAL-ARMY. Shelter addresses and phones were not listed on the site; use the main office number.
records.description_es: Maneja albergues de emergencia, como el Austin Shelter y el Rathgeber Center para familias. También ofrece comidas y ayuda con renta y servicios públicos para evitar que las personas pierdan su casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias en crisis o sin hogar en el área de Austin. Comuníquese con la oficina para conocer las reglas de cada programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina principal para preguntar por albergue o ayuda con renta y servicios públicos.

records.name: LifeWorks Youth Shelter and Drop-In Center
records.description_en: Emergency shelter and a drop-in center for young people experiencing homelessness, plus counseling, basic needs help, education, and job services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Emergency shelter is for youth 17 and younger. Young adults 18 and older can get other programs and referrals.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office number for emergency shelter or services.
records.notes: max_age 17 applies to emergency shelter only; other LifeWorks programs serve older youth.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia y un centro de atención sin cita para jóvenes sin hogar, además de consejería, ayuda con necesidades básicas, educación y servicios de empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El albergue de emergencia es para jóvenes de 17 años o menos. Los jóvenes de 18 años o más pueden recibir otros programas y referencias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para pedir albergue de emergencia u otros servicios.

records.name: First Steps Housing Stability Program
records.description_en: Helps people at risk of losing their home with rent help and case management, and offers supportive housing and services for veteran families.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Austin facing a housing crisis. Front Steps says it works with people who have criminal, eviction, or credit history.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online on the Front Steps website or call the office.
records.notes: Veteran families apply at frontsteps.org/veteran-families-application/. Email info@frontsteps.org. Specific eligibility rules were not listed.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas en riesgo de perder su casa con ayuda para la renta y manejo de casos, y ofrece vivienda con apoyo y servicios para familias de veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Austin que pasan por una crisis de vivienda. Front Steps dice que trabaja con personas que tienen antecedentes penales, desalojos o mal crédito.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en la página web de Front Steps o llame a la oficina.

records.name: Public Housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8)
records.organization: Austin Housing Authority (formerly Housing Authority of the City of Austin, HACA)
records.description_en: Offers low-cost public housing, rental vouchers, and other affordable housing programs in the City of Austin.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Final eligibility is checked when your name reaches the top of the wait list. Wait times can be 6 months to over 3 years.
documents_needed: Email address (required to apply online)
Full names, Social Security numbers, and birth dates for household members
Estimated gross income
Mailing address
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the pre-application on the online portal using any computer, tablet, or phone. You must have an email address.
records.cost: Free to apply; rent based on income
records.notes: Portal now brands the agency as Austin Housing Authority. Phone confirmed on the official application portal; hacanet.org could not be loaded (certificate error), so the street address was not confirmed and was removed.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda pública de bajo costo, vales de renta y otros programas de vivienda económica en la Ciudad de Austin.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos. Se revisa si califica cuando su nombre llega al primer lugar de la lista de espera. La espera puede ser de 6 meses a más de 3 años.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la pre-solicitud en el portal en línea desde cualquier computadora, tableta o teléfono. Necesita tener correo electrónico.

records.name: Housing Authority of Travis County (HATC)
records.description_en: Offers affordable housing for seniors, people with disabilities, and families, Housing Choice Voucher rent help, homelessness programs, and a Family Self-Sufficiency program.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Travis County. Program rules vary.
records.how_to_apply: Schedule an appointment online in advance; walk-ins are no longer accepted.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1-4 p.m.; Fri 8 a.m.-12 p.m.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda económica para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades y familias, ayuda de renta con vales (Housing Choice Voucher), programas para personas sin hogar y un programa de Autosuficiencia Familiar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en el condado de Travis. Las reglas cambian según el programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita en línea con anticipación; ya no se atiende sin cita.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid - Austin Office
records.description_en: Free legal help for people with low income, including help with evictions and other civil legal problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people in TRLA's 68-county service area, which includes Travis County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake hotline on weekdays to apply for free legal help.
records.hours: Intake: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Central
records.notes: Toll-free intake: (833) 329-8752. Income limits not listed on the page.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis para personas de bajos ingresos, incluso con desalojos y otros problemas legales civiles.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos en los 68 condados que atiende TRLA, incluido el condado de Travis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión entre semana para solicitar ayuda legal gratis.

records.name: Austin Tenants Council
records.description_en: Counselors explain renters' rights, landlord-tenant problems, repairs, and fair housing. They also help with housing discrimination complaints.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For renters in the Austin area with landlord-tenant or fair housing questions.
records.how_to_apply: Call during business hours to set up an appointment, or fill out the online intake form in English or Spanish.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 9 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1-4 p.m.; Fri 9 a.m.-12 p.m.
records.notes: Staff are housing advocates, not attorneys, and cannot give legal advice. Project of TRLA since December 2022.
records.description_es: Consejeros le explican sus derechos como inquilino, problemas con el dueño, reparaciones y vivienda justa. También ayudan con quejas por discriminación en la vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos del área de Austin con preguntas sobre problemas con el dueño o vivienda justa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame en horario de oficina para hacer una cita, o llene el formulario de admisión en línea en inglés o español.

records.name: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
records.organization: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
records.description_en: Free legal advice from volunteer lawyers on civil problems like landlord-tenant, family, consumer, employment, bankruptcy, wills, probate, and record clearing.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Based on household income, assets, where you live, and the legal problem. Does not help with criminal, immigration, or civil rights cases.
records.how_to_apply: Attend an in-person legal advice clinic or sign up for a phone clinic through the website, or call the office.
records.notes: Income limits and exact counties served were not stated on the page.
records.description_es: Consejo legal gratis de abogados voluntarios para problemas civiles como renta, familia, deudas de consumo, empleo, bancarrota, testamentos, herencias y limpieza de antecedentes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Depende de los ingresos y bienes del hogar, dónde vive y el tipo de problema legal. No ayuda con casos penales, de inmigración ni de derechos civiles.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a una clínica de consejo legal en persona, inscríbase en una clínica por teléfono en la página web, o llame a la oficina.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Capital Area - North Career Center
records.description_en: A free job center that helps with job searches, career coaching, training for in-demand jobs, youth and veteran services, and free computer, fax, and phone use.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job search services are free and open to everyone. Training scholarships require U.S. work authorization, Austin/Travis County residency, and one more job, income, or education requirement.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in or call to set an appointment. New job seekers can sign up for a Career Info Session online.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Appointment line: 512-381-5100. Vocational Rehabilitation Services: 512-485-3734.
records.description_es: Un centro de empleo gratis que ayuda a buscar trabajo, da orientación de carrera, capacitación para trabajos con demanda, servicios para jóvenes y veteranos, y uso gratis de computadora, fax y teléfono.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los servicios para buscar trabajo son gratis y para todos. Las becas de capacitación piden permiso para trabajar en EE. UU., vivir en Austin o el condado de Travis, y cumplir con otro requisito de trabajo, ingresos o estudios.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita o llame para hacer una cita. Si es nuevo, puede inscribirse en una Sesión Informativa de Carrera en línea.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Capital Area - East Career Center
records.description_en: A free job center at ACC Eastview that helps with job searches, career coaching, training, and free computer, fax, and phone use.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job search services are free and open to everyone. Training scholarships have extra requirements.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in or call to set an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Located at Austin Community College Eastview Campus.
records.description_es: Un centro de empleo gratis en ACC Eastview que ayuda a buscar trabajo, da orientación de carrera, capacitación y uso gratis de computadora, fax y teléfono.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los servicios para buscar trabajo son gratis y para todos. Las becas de capacitación tienen requisitos adicionales.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita o llame para hacer una cita.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Subsidy)
records.description_en: Helps working parents and parents in school or training pay for child care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Austin/Travis County parents who qualify under the state child care program rules. Contact the office to check eligibility.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email Child Care Services to learn how to apply.
records.notes: Email: austinccs@wfscapitalarea.com. Wait lists may apply.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado infantil a padres que trabajan, estudian o están en capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para padres de Austin y el condado de Travis que califican según las reglas del programa estatal de cuidado infantil. Comuníquese con la oficina para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo electrónico a Child Care Services para saber cómo solicitar.

records.name: Travis County Veterans Services
records.description_en: Free help from accredited staff to apply for VA benefits, disability claims, and appeals, plus referrals for health care, housing, education, and money help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans who live in Travis County and their eligible dependents.
records.how_to_apply: Call or fill out the online form to make a virtual or in-person appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 9 a.m.-4 p.m., by appointment only
records.notes: Veterans Crisis Line (listed on the page): 1-800-273-8255 press 1, or text 838255. For VA claim deadlines within 30 days, contact the VA at 1-800-827-1000.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis de personal acreditado para solicitar beneficios del VA, reclamos por discapacidad y apelaciones, además de referencias para salud, vivienda, educación y ayuda con dinero.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos que viven en el condado de Travis y sus familiares que califican.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o llene el formulario en línea para hacer una cita virtual o en persona.

records.name: Integral Care (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Travis County's public mental health agency. It offers a 24/7 crisis line, counseling, psychiatry, substance use treatment, and help for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves people in Travis County with mental health conditions, substance use disorders, or intellectual and developmental disabilities. Anyone can call the crisis line.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis and help line to get connected to services.
records.hours: Crisis line 24/7
records.notes: Crisis line is 512-472-HELP (4357). Toll-free 844-398-8252; TTY 512-703-1395. Website is offered in many languages; spoken-language services were not confirmed.
records.description_es: La agencia pública de salud mental del condado de Travis. Tiene una línea de crisis las 24 horas, consejería, psiquiatría, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias y ayuda para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a personas en el condado de Travis con problemas de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo. Cualquier persona puede llamar a la línea de crisis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis y ayuda, abierta las 24 horas, para conectarse con los servicios.

records.name: CommUnityCare Health Centers
records.description_en: Community health centers that offer primary care, pediatrics, women's health, dental, behavioral health, HIV care, and care for people experiencing homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to patients in Travis County. Call the Patient Navigation Center to ask about costs and whether you qualify for Central Health MAP.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Patient Navigation Center to make an appointment. Current patients can also schedule through MyChart.
records.notes: Carousel Pediatrics 512-744-6000; OB/GYN 512-978-8700. Dental: call your clinic. Sliding-scale fee details were not listed on the page.
records.description_es: Centros de salud comunitarios que ofrecen atención primaria, pediatría, salud de la mujer, dental, salud mental, atención del VIH y atención para personas sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a pacientes en el condado de Travis. Llame al Centro de Navegación de Pacientes para preguntar por los costos y si califica para el programa MAP de Central Health.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Centro de Navegación de Pacientes para hacer una cita. Si ya es paciente, también puede hacer citas en MyChart.

records.name: Medical Access Program (MAP and MAP Basic)
records.description_en: Low-cost health coverage for uninsured Travis County residents. It helps members get doctor visits and other care. It is not insurance.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For uninsured Travis County residents with household income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level, based on the last 30 days of income.
documents_needed: Proof of Travis County residence (lease, utility bill, or recent postmarked mail)
Picture ID for adults
Proof of U.S. citizenship or residency status
Proof of monthly income
Current health insurance cards, if any
Proof of household size (such as birth certificates)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online 24/7, call to apply by phone or schedule an in-person appointment, or mail your application.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Phone option 1. Interpreters available; Relay Texas 711. Mail: PO Box 300489, Austin, TX 78703. Monthly income limit example: $2,660 for 1 person; $5,500 for 4.
records.description_es: Cobertura médica de bajo costo para residentes del condado de Travis sin seguro. Ayuda a los miembros a ir al doctor y recibir otra atención. No es un seguro médico.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Travis sin seguro médico, con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza, según los ingresos de los últimos 30 días.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea a cualquier hora, llame para solicitar por teléfono o hacer una cita en persona (opción 1), o mande su solicitud por correo. Hay intérpretes disponibles.

records.name: WIC (Women, Infants and Children)
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition advice, breastfeeding support, and referrals to pregnant women, new mothers, and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, breastfeeding women, women who had a baby in the last 6 months, and children under 5 (parents, including fathers, and guardians can enroll them). Families on Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF automatically meet the income rule.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at texaswic.org/apply or call Austin Public Health WIC. There are 13 clinics plus a mobile unit.
records.notes: Serves Austin, Travis County, and Bastrop County. State WIC line: 800-942-3678. Mobile unit schedule: austintexas.gov/health/wic-mobile-unit-schedule. Eligibility rules left empty so pregnant women are not excluded.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, consejos de nutrición, apoyo para la lactancia y referencias a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mujeres que dan pecho, mujeres que tuvieron un bebé en los últimos 6 meses y niños menores de 5 años (los padres, incluso los papás, y los tutores pueden inscribirlos). Las familias con Medicaid, SNAP o TANF cumplen automáticamente con la regla de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en texaswic.org/apply o llame a WIC de Austin Public Health. Hay 13 clínicas y una unidad móvil.

records.name: Equifare Low-Income Discount Fare
records.description_en: Gives lower bus and train fares to riders with low income, with daily and monthly fare caps.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For riders with household income below 200% of the federal poverty level, or who are enrolled in certain social service programs.
documents_needed: Proof of eligibility such as EBT, a Social Security award letter, a pay stub, or a tax return
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online Equifare application (about 15 minutes) or pick up a paper form at the Transit Store (1705 Guadalupe St.). Approval takes about 4-6 business days. You must use a CapMetro Reloadable Fare Card or the Umo app.
records.notes: Email Equifare@capmetro.org. Enrollment lasts 24 months. Local bus single ride $1.00 with Equifare.
records.description_es: Da tarifas más bajas de autobús y tren a pasajeros de bajos ingresos, con un límite de pago por día y por mes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para pasajeros con ingresos del hogar menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza, o que están inscritos en ciertos programas de servicios sociales.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de Equifare en línea (unos 15 minutos) o pida una solicitud en papel en la Transit Store (1705 Guadalupe St.). La aprobación tarda unos 4 a 6 días hábiles. Debe usar una tarjeta recargable de CapMetro o la app Umo.

records.name: Reduced Fare ID Card Program
records.description_en: A $3 ID card that lets people with disabilities ride MetroBus, MetroExpress, and MetroRail for a reduced fare.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with a physical or mental disability (permanent or temporary) that makes regular transit harder to use. A health care professional must sign the form. Economic need alone does not qualify.
documents_needed: Completed application with medical verification signed by a qualified health care professional
Valid government-issued photo ID or Texas driver's license
records.how_to_apply: Get the application at the Transit Store, online, or by calling. Return it within 30 days of the medical signature in person, by mail, or by fax to (512) 369-6072. Pick up the card at the Transit Store with photo ID.
records.hours: Cards issued Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.
records.notes: Packet revised 2/2025. Transit Store phone 512-389-7475 (8 a.m.-5 p.m. weekdays); CapMetro Customer Service 512-474-1200. Payment: cash, credit card, or money order (the application form says no personal checks).
records.description_es: Una tarjeta de identificación de $3 que permite a personas con discapacidades viajar en MetroBus, MetroExpress y MetroRail con tarifa reducida.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con una discapacidad física o mental (permanente o temporal) que les hace más difícil usar el transporte regular. Un profesional de salud debe firmar el formulario. Tener pocos ingresos no es suficiente para calificar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida la solicitud en la Transit Store, en línea o por teléfono. Entréguela en persona, por correo o por fax al (512) 369-6072 dentro de los 30 días después de la firma médica. Recoja la tarjeta en la Transit Store con una identificación con foto.

records.name: CapMetro Access (Paratransit)
records.description_en: Shared door-to-door rides for people whose disability keeps them from using regular buses and trains, within 3/4 mile of CapMetro routes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people certified through CapMetro's in-person eligibility review because a disability prevents them from using fixed-route service.
documents_needed: Part A application
Part B form completed by a qualified health care professional
records.how_to_apply: Submit Part A online and have a health care professional complete Part B, then complete the in-person eligibility review. Contact the eligibility office with questions.
records.hours: Service 4:00 a.m.-3:59 a.m. (exceptions apply)
records.notes: Book rides at 512-852-7272 or the CapMetro Access app. Eligibility email: eligibility@capmetro.org.
records.description_es: Viajes compartidos de puerta a puerta para personas que por una discapacidad no pueden usar los autobuses y trenes regulares, dentro de 3/4 de milla de las rutas de CapMetro.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas aprobadas en la revisión en persona de CapMetro porque una discapacidad no les deja usar las rutas regulares.
records.how_to_apply_es: Mande la Parte A en línea y pida a un profesional de salud que llene la Parte B; luego haga la revisión en persona. Si tiene preguntas, llame a la oficina de elegibilidad.

records.name: Foundation Communities Affordable Housing and Prosper Centers
records.description_en: Runs 28 affordable apartment communities and offers free tax preparation, financial coaching, college guidance, and health insurance enrollment help at its Prosper Centers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Housing is for households that meet income rules for each property. Contact Foundation Communities for program details.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Foundation Communities website (Housing > Get Started) to apply for housing, or call to ask about free tax help and coaching.
records.hours: Office: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Services free; rent varies by property
records.notes: Prosper Centers (South: 2900 S IH 35; North: 5900 Airport Blvd) phone 737-717-4000. ECHO lists 512-610-4010 for Foundation Communities; the phone above is from foundcom.org.
records.description_es: Maneja 28 comunidades de apartamentos económicos y ofrece preparación de impuestos gratis, asesoría financiera, orientación para la universidad y ayuda para inscribirse en un seguro médico en sus Prosper Centers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: La vivienda es para hogares que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos de cada propiedad. Comuníquese con Foundation Communities para más detalles.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la página web de Foundation Communities (Housing > Get Started) para solicitar vivienda, o llame para preguntar por la ayuda gratis con impuestos y asesoría.
